GLP-1 receptor agonists and dual GIP/GLP-1 agonists are recommended for weight management in patients with type 2 diabetes and obesity, given their combined glycemic and weight benefits. [ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes, American Diabetes Association, 2024]

It is also important to maintain an A1C goal of less than 7% without significant hypoglycemia. Metformin is preferred as the initial pharmacologic agent for these patients. [ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes, American Diabetes Association, 2024] While GLP-1 drugs are indicated for weight loss and glycemic control, they should be used concurrently with lifestyle modifications. Please consult a healthcare provider to determine if it's appropriate for your health condition.
